gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 798.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following road will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Private road within K.I.L. 4209, immediately to the north-west and parallel to Perth Street as shown coloured pink on drawing No. R.K. 210 signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 31st July, 1951. Proposed Name: TWEED ROAD. Chinese Version: 陶域道.
